# Tech Exchange

> Tech Exchange is Nepal's developer community and engineering studio for practical learning, thoughtful collaboration, and software services.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.techexchange.dev/): Overview of the Tech Exchange community and engineering studio.
- [about](https://www.techexchange.dev/about): Mission, culture, and remote career opportunities at Tech Exchange. See the careers section at /about#careers.
- [services](https://www.techexchange.dev/services): Software engineering, AI agent, web application, and consulting services.

## Careers

- [about#careers](https://www.techexchange.dev/about#careers): Open remote engineering and media roles at Tech Exchange.
